response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack software engineering experience with strong leadership and open-source contributions, but his AI/GenAI-specific experience is limited to recent work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks. While he meets most required qualifications technically, there is insufficient evidence of deep expertise in vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent systems. His transition into AI roles is promising but not yet fully demonstrated at the staff level.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background with leadership experience in staff roles
Recent direct experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks
Proven ability to design and deploy scalable systems (e.g., Geo-Data platform, Direct Mail automation)
concerns: Limited explicit experience with vector databases and RAG architectures
No clear evidence of multi-agent system frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI) implementation
AI/GenAI work appears to be a recent shift; depth of experience unclear
